items.title: Group commit: batch size vs. throughput vs. data-loss window
items.description: One fsync per commit is safest but slow. Batching several commits behind one shared fsync (group commit) raises throughput — but every commit sitting in an unflushed batch is, by definition, not yet durable. Drag the batch size and the fsync/write latencies to see both sides of that trade-off move, using the same numbers as L2's table.
